title: Carry typed tool input schemas into the local-model catalog
goal: Preserve built-in CoreTools JSON input schemas when the PlaneBus tool catalog is serialized, so GEMI can give local engines the required parameters while dynamic proxies remain explicit passthrough entries.

results.implementation: Built-in CoreTools schemas now travel through susi-tools, PlaneBus, the legacy GMCP facade, and the daemon EngineHooks bridge into GEMI's local-model tool catalog. Dynamic MCP and Wasm entries remain explicit schema-less passthrough entries.
results.gate: SUSI_LOCAL_TEST_RUNNER=serial cargo run --offline --locked -p xtask --bin local-workflow -- check: passed in 117.8s; format, clippy, affected tests, guard tests, GMCP requirements and doc-tests all passed
results.gmcp_evidence: scripts/gmcp-record-evidence.sh: 54 requirement checks; --mastery: 9 checks; all current on the final source commit
results.ceilings: lean_core_ceilings: 2 passed, 0 failed; susi-gmcp 25860/25860 and susi-gemi 21262/21262, with no ceiling increase

limitations: Dynamic external MCP and Wasm reflex entries still omit schemas when discovery does not provide one; they retain the explicit passthrough behavior.
Windows qualification remains a separate native-host task.
